title: 30-Second Cinematic AI Video Prompt
content:
30-Second Cinematic AI Video Prompt

Create a highly realistic cinematic fantasy action-comedy scene inside an ancient wooden tavern at night. The environment is dark, atmospheric and richly detailed, with wooden walls, traditional furniture, hanging lanterns, warm orange candlelight, smoke and subtle background patrons.

Character 1: A beautiful pale-skinned female warrior with long platinum-white hair, wearing a black-and-deep-red leather fantasy warrior outfit with metallic details. She carries an oversized sword and has a serious, confident expression.

Character 2: A heavy-set East Asian woman wearing simple loose grey traditional clothing. She initially appears relaxed and harmless but gradually reveals surprising strength and a powerful personality.

Scene 1 — Entrance | 0–5 seconds

The tavern doors suddenly open. The white-haired warrior slowly walks inside carrying her huge sword. Low-angle cinematic shot following her boots, then tilt upward to reveal her face.

She looks around the tavern and notices the heavy-set woman sitting at a table.

Warrior, in natural English, confidently:
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

The woman looks up from her food, completely unimpressed.

Woman:
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

Use realistic lip-sync, natural facial expressions and subtle background tavern sounds.

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

The warrior approaches the table and places one hand on her sword.

Warrior:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

The woman casually takes another bite of food.

Woman:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

The warrior becomes irritated.

Warrior:
“I don't think you understand who you're dealing with.”

The woman slowly smiles.

Woman:
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

Scene 3 — Fight Begins | 10–17 seconds

Suddenly the warrior swings her enormous sword.

Use dynamic handheld cinematography and fast martial-arts choreography. The woman quickly moves aside, surprisingly agile despite her size.

The sword crashes into the wooden table, sending pieces of wood and food flying.

The woman grabs the warrior and throws her backward.

Warrior, shocked:
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

Woman:
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

Scene 4 — Fire Attack | 17–23 seconds

The warrior gets back up and charges again.

The woman takes a deep breath.

A mysterious orange glow begins building inside her mouth.

The warrior stops suddenly.

Warrior:
“What the hell are you doing?”

The woman exhales a powerful burst of magical fire toward her.

Create a dramatic, realistic fire effect illuminating the entire tavern. The warrior narrowly avoids the flames but gets thrown backward by the force of the blast.

Scene 5 — Defeat | 23–27 seconds

The warrior crashes onto the wooden floor.

The woman walks toward her calmly.

The warrior tries to crawl away and looks completely stunned.

Warrior:
“Okay… I admit it. I underestimated you.”

The woman steps closer and places one foot firmly beside the warrior, looking down at her.

Scene 6 — Final Shot | 27–30 seconds

Extreme close-up of the woman's face.

She looks directly at the warrior with a calm, almost amused expression.

Woman, quietly:
“Next time… ask questions before swinging a sword.”

Cut to black.

Visual Style

Ultra-realistic cinematic fantasy film, high-budget movie production, realistic human faces, detailed skin texture, natural hair movement, physically accurate clothing, realistic sword physics, believable martial-arts choreography, cinematic fire VFX, volumetric smoke, warm lantern lighting, dramatic shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic motion blur, atmospheric particles, detailed medieval tavern environment, professional Hollywood cinematography.

Use a mixture of wide establishing shots, low-angle hero shots, medium dialogue shots, close-ups, over-the-shoulder shots and dynamic tracking shots during the fight.

Natural English spoken dialogue with accurate lip synchronization. Distinct voices for both characters. Add realistic tavern ambience, wooden furniture sounds, footsteps, sword impacts, cloth movement, fire whoosh, impact sounds and subtle cinematic background music.

The dialogue should sound natural and conversational rather than theatrical. Maintain consistent character appearance, costumes, hairstyle and facial identity throughout the entire video.

Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Duration: approximately 30 seconds.
Realistic cinematic quality, coherent continuous action, no subtitles, no text, no watermark.

Prompt cinematográfico de IA de 30 segundos

Crea una escena de fantasía de acción y comedia, altamente realista y cinematográfica, dentro de una antigua taberna de madera por la noche. El entorno es oscuro, atmosférico y ricamente detallado, con paredes de madera, muebles tradicionales, faroles colgantes, cálida luz naranja de velas, humo y clientes de fondo sutiles.

Character 1: Una hermosa guerrera de piel pálida, con el cabello largo blanco platino, vestida con un atuendo de guerrera fantástica de cuero negro y rojo oscuro con detalles metálicos. Lleva una espada sobredimensionada y tiene una expresión seria y segura.

Character 2: Una mujer de Asia oriental, corpulenta, que viste ropa tradicional gris, sencilla y holgada. Al principio parece relajada e inofensiva, pero poco a poco revela una fuerza sorprendente y una personalidad poderosa.

Scene 1 — Entrance | 0–5 seconds

Las puertas de la taberna se abren de repente. La guerrera de cabello blanco entra lentamente cargando su enorme espada. Toma cinematográfica en ángulo bajo siguiendo sus botas, luego tilt upward para revelar su rostro.

Mira alrededor de la taberna y nota a la mujer corpulenta sentada en una mesa.

Warrior, in natural English, confidently:
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

La mujer levanta la vista de su comida, completamente imperturbable.

Woman:
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

Usa lip-sync realista, expresiones faciales naturales y sonidos sutiles de ambiente de taberna de fondo.

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

La guerrera se acerca a la mesa y coloca una mano sobre su espada.

Warrior:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

La mujer sigue comiendo con total calma.

Woman:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

La guerrera se irrita.

Warrior:
“I don't think you understand who you’re dealing with.”

La mujer sonríe lentamente.

Woman:
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

Scene 3 — Fight Begins | 10–17 seconds

De repente, la guerrera blande su enorme espada.

Usa cinematografía dinámica en handheld y una coreografía rápida de artes marciales. La mujer se aparta con rapidez, sorprendentemente ágil a pesar de su tamaño.

La espada se estrella contra la mesa de madera, lanzando trozos de madera y comida por los aires.

La mujer agarra a la guerrera y la lanza hacia atrás.

Warrior, shocked:
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

Woman:
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

Scene 4 — Fire Attack | 17–23 seconds

La guerrera se levanta y vuelve a cargar.

La mujer toma una respiración profunda.

Un misterioso resplandor naranja comienza a acumularse dentro de su boca.

La guerrera se detiene de golpe.

Warrior:
“What the hell are you doing?”

La mujer exhala una poderosa ráfaga de fuego mágico hacia ella.

Crea un efecto de fuego dramático y realista que ilumine toda la taberna. La guerrera apenas logra esquivar las llamas, pero sale despedida hacia atrás por la fuerza de la explosión.

Scene 5 — Defeat | 23–27 seconds

La guerrera cae estrepitosamente sobre el suelo de madera.

La mujer camina hacia ella con calma.

La guerrera intenta arrastrarse para alejarse y parece completamente atónita.

Warrior:
“Okay… I admit it. I underestimated you.”

La mujer se acerca y planta firmemente un pie junto a la guerrera, mirándola desde arriba.

Scene 6 — Final Shot | 27–30 seconds

Primerísimo primer plano del rostro de la mujer.

Mira directamente a la guerrera con una expresión tranquila, casi divertida.

Woman, quietly:
“Next time… ask questions before swinging a sword.”

Corte a negro.

Visual Style

Película de fantasía cinematográfica ultra realista, producción de alto presupuesto, rostros humanos realistas, textura detallada de la piel, movimiento natural del cabello, ropa físicamente precisa, física realista de la espada, coreografía de artes marciales creíble, VFX de fuego cinematográficos, humo volumétrico, iluminación cálida de faroles, sombras dramáticas, profundidad de campo reducida, motion blur realista, partículas atmosféricas, entorno de taberna medieval detallado, cinematografía profesional de Hollywood.

Usa una mezcla de planos generales de establecimiento, hero shots en ángulo bajo, planos medios de diálogo, primeros planos, planos over-the-shoulder y tomas dinámicas de seguimiento durante la pelea.

Diálogo hablado en inglés natural con sincronización labial precisa. Voces distintas para ambos personajes. Añade ambiente realista de taberna, sonidos de muebles de madera, pasos, impactos de espada, movimiento de la ropa, whoosh de fuego, sonidos de impacto y música de fondo cinematográfica sutil.

El diálogo debe sonar natural y conversacional, no teatral. Mantén una apariencia, vestuario, peinado e identidad facial consistentes de los personajes durante todo el video.

Relación de aspecto: 16:9.
Duración: aproximadamente 30 segundos.
Calidad cinematográfica realista, acción continua coherente, sin subtítulos, sin texto, sin marca de agua.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Audio

Diálogo hablado en inglés natural con sincronización labial precisa. Voces distintas para ambos personajes. Añade ambiente realista de taberna, sonidos de muebles de madera, pasos, impactos de espada, movimiento de la ropa, whoosh de fuego, sonidos de impacto y música de fondo cinematográfica sutil.

El diálogo debe sonar natural y conversacional, no teatral. Mantén una apariencia, vestuario, peinado e identidad facial consistentes de los personajes durante todo el video.

Relación de aspecto: 16:9.
Duración: aproximadamente 30 segundos.
Calidad cinematográfica realista, acción continua coherente, sin subtítulos, sin texto, sin marca de agua.

30秒のシネマティックAI動画プロンプト

夜の古い木造の酒場の中で、非常にリアルなシネマティック・ファンタジーのアクションコメディシーンを作成する。環境は暗く、雰囲気があり、細部まで作り込まれている。木の壁、伝統的な家具、吊り下げられたランタン、温かいオレンジ色のろうそくの光、煙、そして控えめな背景の客たちが見える。

Character 1: 長いプラチナホワイトの髪を持つ、美しい色白の女性戦士。金属ディテールのある黒と深紅のレザー製ファンタジー戦士衣装を着ている。巨大な剣を携え、真剣で自信に満ちた表情をしている。

Character 2: シンプルでゆったりしたグレーの伝統衣装を着た、ふくよかな東アジア系の女性。最初はリラックスして無害そうに見えるが、徐々に驚くほどの強さと強烈な個性を見せる。

Scene 1 — Entrance | 0–5 seconds

酒場の扉が突然開く。白髪の戦士が巨大な剣を持って、ゆっくりと中へ入ってくる。彼女のブーツを追うローアングルのシネマティックショットから始め、そこからティルトアップして顔を見せる。

彼女は酒場を見回し、テーブルに座っているふくよかな女性に気づく。

Warrior, in natural English, confidently:
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

女性は食事から顔を上げ、まったく動じない。

Woman:
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

リアルなリップシンク、自然な表情、そして控えめな酒場の環境音を使用する。

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

戦士がテーブルに近づき、片手を剣に置く。

Warrior:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

女性は何気なく、もう一口食べる。

Woman:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

戦士は苛立つ。

Warrior:
“I don't think you understand who you’re dealing with.”

女性はゆっくりと笑みを浮かべる。

Woman:
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

Scene 3 — Fight Begins | 10–17 seconds

突然、戦士が巨大な剣を振るう。

ダイナミックなハンドヘルドの撮影と、素早い武術の振り付けを使う。女性は、体格に反して驚くほど俊敏に、すばやく横へ避ける。

剣は木のテーブルに激突し、木片と食べ物が飛び散る。

女性は戦士をつかみ、後方へ投げ飛ばす。

Warrior, shocked:
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

Woman:
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

Scene 4 — Fire Attack | 17–23 seconds

戦士は立ち上がり、再び突進する。

女性は深く息を吸う。

彼女の口の中で、謎めいたオレンジ色の光が徐々に強まっていく。

戦士は突然立ち止まる。

Warrior:
“What the hell are you doing?”

女性は強力な魔法の炎を彼女に向かって吐き出す。

酒場全体を照らす、ドラマチックでリアルな炎のエフェクトを作成する。戦士は炎をかろうじて避けるが、爆風の力で後方へ吹き飛ばされる。

Scene 5 — Defeat | 23–27 seconds

戦士は木の床に叩きつけられる。

女性は落ち着いて彼女の方へ歩いていく。

戦士は這って逃げようとし、完全に呆然としている。

Warrior:
“Okay… I admit it. I underestimated you.”

女性はさらに近づき、戦士のすぐ横に片足をしっかりと置いて、見下ろす。

Scene 6 — Final Shot | 27–30 seconds

女性の顔の極端なクローズアップ。

彼女は落ち着いた、少し面白がっているような表情で、戦士をまっすぐ見る。

Woman, quietly:
“Next time… ask questions before swinging a sword.”

黒画面に切り替わる。

Visual Style

超リアルなシネマティック・ファンタジー映画、高予算の映画制作、リアルな人間の顔、詳細な肌の質感、自然な髪の動き、物理的に正確な衣装、リアルな剣の物理挙動、説得力のある武術の振り付け、シネマティックな炎のVFX、ボリューメトリックな煙、温かいランタン照明、ドラマチックな影、浅い被写界深度、リアルなモーションブラー、雰囲気のある粒子、細部まで作り込まれた中世の酒場環境、プロフェッショナルなハリウッド撮影。

ワイドなエスタブリッシングショット、ローアングルのヒーローショット、ミディアムの会話ショット、クローズアップ、オーバー・ザ・ショルダーショット、そして戦闘中のダイナミックなトラッキングショットを組み合わせて使用する。

自然な英語のセリフ、正確なリップシンク。2人のキャラクターに明確に異なる声を与える。リアルな酒場の環境音、木製家具の音、足音、剣の衝突音、衣擦れ、炎の噴射音、衝撃音、そして控えめなシネマティックBGMを加える。

セリフは演劇的ではなく、自然で会話的に聞こえるようにする。動画全体を通して、キャラクターの見た目、衣装、髪型、顔のアイデンティティを一貫して維持する。

長さ: 約30秒。

30초 시네마틱 AI 비디오 프롬프트

밤의 고대 목조 선술집 안에서 매우 사실적인 시네마틱 판타지 액션 코미디 장면을 만들어라. 환경은 어둡고 분위기 있으며 디테일이 풍부해야 한다. 나무 벽, 전통 가구, 매달린 랜턴, 따뜻한 주황빛 촛불, 연기, 그리고 은은한 배경 손님들이 보인다.

Character 1: 긴 플래티넘 화이트 헤어를 가진 아름다운 창백한 피부의 여성 전사. 메탈릭 디테일이 있는 검정과 짙은 붉은색의 가죽 판타지 전사 복장을 입고 있다. 거대한 검을 들고 있으며, 진지하고 자신감 있는 표정을 짓고 있다.

Character 2: 단순하고 헐렁한 회색 전통 의상을 입은 체격이 큰 동아시아 여성. 처음에는 편안하고 무해해 보이지만, 점차 놀라운 힘과 강한 개성을 드러낸다.

Scene 1 — Entrance | 0–5 seconds

선술집 문이 갑자기 열린다. 흰 머리의 전사가 거대한 검을 들고 천천히 안으로 들어온다. 그녀의 부츠를 따라가는 로우 앵글 시네마틱 샷에서 시작해, 카메라가 위로 틸트되며 얼굴을 드러낸다.

그녀는 선술집 안을 둘러보다가 테이블에 앉아 있는 체격이 큰 여성을 발견한다.

전사, 자연스러운 영어로 자신 있게:
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

여성은 음식을 먹다 고개를 들어 올리지만, 전혀 감흥이 없다는 표정이다.

여성:
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

리얼한 립싱크, 자연스러운 표정 연기, 그리고 은은한 배경 선술집 소음을 사용한다.

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

전사가 테이블로 다가가 한 손을 검에 올린다.

전사:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

여성은 태연하게 음식을 한 입 더 먹는다.

여성:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

전사는 짜증을 내기 시작한다.

전사:

Prompt Cinematográfico de IA de 30 Segundos

Crie uma cena de ação-comédia de fantasia cinematográfica, altamente realista, dentro de uma antiga taverna de madeira à noite. O ambiente é escuro, atmosférico e ricamente detalhado, com paredes de madeira, móveis tradicionais, lanternas penduradas, luz quente de velas alaranjadas, fumaça e frequentadores sutis ao fundo.

Character 1: A beautiful pale-skinned female warrior with long platinum-white hair, wearing a black-and-deep-red leather fantasy warrior outfit with metallic details. She carries an oversized sword and has a serious, confident expression.

Character 2: A heavy-set East Asian woman wearing simple loose grey traditional clothing. She initially appears relaxed and harmless but gradually reveals surprising strength and a powerful personality.

Scene 1 — Entrance | 0–5 seconds

The tavern doors suddenly open. The white-haired warrior slowly walks inside carrying her huge sword. Low-angle cinematic shot following her boots, then tilt upward to reveal her face.

She looks around the tavern and notices the heavy-set woman sitting at a table.

Warrior, in natural English, confidently:
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

The woman looks up from her food, completely unimpressed.

Woman:
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

Use realistic lip-sync, natural facial expressions and subtle background tavern sounds.

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

The warrior approaches the table and places one hand on her sword.

Warrior:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

The woman casually takes another bite of food.

Woman:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

The warrior becomes irritated.

Warrior:
“I don't think you understand who you're dealing with.”

The woman slowly smiles.

Woman:
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

Scene 3 — Fight Begins | 10–17 seconds

Suddenly the warrior swings her enormous sword.

Use dynamic handheld cinematography and fast martial-arts choreography. The woman quickly moves aside, surprisingly agile despite her size.

The sword crashes into the wooden table, sending pieces of wood and food flying.

The woman grabs the warrior and throws her backward.

Warrior, shocked:
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

Woman:
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

Scene 4 — Fire Attack | 17–23 seconds

The warrior gets back up and charges again.

The woman takes a deep breath.

A mysterious orange glow begins building inside her mouth.

The warrior stops suddenly.

Warrior:
“What the hell are you doing?”

The woman exhales a powerful burst of magical fire toward her.

Create a dramatic, realistic fire effect illuminating the entire tavern. The warrior narrowly avoids the flames but gets thrown backward by the force of the blast.

Scene 5 — Defeat | 23–27 seconds

The warrior crashes onto the wooden floor.

The woman walks toward her calmly.

The warrior tries to crawl away and looks completely stunned.

Warrior:
“Okay… I admit it. I underestimated you.”

The woman steps closer and places one foot firmly beside the warrior, looking down at her.

Scene 6 — Final Shot | 27–30 seconds

Extreme close-up of the woman's face.

She looks directly at the warrior with a calm, almost amused expression.

Woman, quietly:
“Next time… ask questions before swinging a sword.”

Cut to black.

Visual Style

Filme de fantasia cinematográfica ultra-realista, produção de alto orçamento, rostos humanos realistas, textura de pele detalhada, movimento natural do cabelo, roupas fisicamente precisas, física realista da espada, coreografia de artes marciais crível, VFX de fogo cinematográfico, fumaça volumétrica, iluminação quente de lanternas, sombras dramáticas, profundidade de campo rasa, motion blur realista, partículas atmosféricas, ambiente detalhado de taverna medieval, cinematografia profissional de Hollywood.

Use a mixture of wide establishing shots, low-angle hero shots, medium dialogue shots, close-ups, over-the-shoulder shots and dynamic tracking shots during the fight.

Natural English spoken dialogue with accurate lip synchronization. Distinct voices for both characters. Add realistic tavern ambience, wooden furniture sounds, footsteps, sword impacts, cloth movement, fire whoosh, impact sounds and subtle cinematic background music.

The dialogue should sound natural and conversational rather than theatrical. Maintain consistent character appearance, costumes, hairstyle and facial identity throughout the entire video.

30秒电影感 AI 视频 prompt

在夜晚的一间古老木质酒馆内，创作一个高度逼真、具有电影感的奇幻动作喜剧场景。环境昏暗、氛围感强、细节丰富，包含木质墙壁、传统家具、悬挂灯笼、温暖的橙色烛光、烟雾，以及背景中若隐若现的少量顾客。

角色1：一位美丽、肤色苍白的女性战士，留着及腰的铂金白长发，身穿黑色与深红色相间、带金属细节的奇幻战士皮革服装。她扛着一把超大的剑，表情严肃而自信。

角色2：一位体型较丰满的东亚女性，穿着朴素宽松的灰色传统服饰。她起初看起来放松且无害，但随后逐渐展现出惊人的力量和强大的气场。

场景1 — 入场 | 0–5秒

酒馆大门突然打开。白发战士扛着巨剑缓缓走入。使用低机位电影镜头跟随她的靴子前进，然后镜头上仰，露出她的脸。

她环顾酒馆，注意到那位坐在桌边的丰满女性。

战士，用自然的英语，自信地说：
“Are you the one they call the Dragon of this tavern?”

那位女性从食物中抬起头，完全不以为意。

女性：
“That depends. Who’s asking?”

使用逼真的口型同步、自然的面部表情，以及细微的酒馆背景音效。

场景2 — 对峙 | 5–10秒

战士走到桌前，一只手按在剑上。

战士：
“I came here to collect a debt.”

那位女性若无其事地又吃了一口食物。

女性：
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

战士开始不耐烦。

战士：
“I don't think you understand who you’re dealing with.”

那位女性缓缓露出微笑。

女性：
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

场景3 — 战斗开始 | 10–17秒

战士突然挥动她那把巨大的剑。

使用动态手持摄影和快速的武术编排。尽管体型较大，那位女性却动作敏捷地迅速闪开。

巨剑砸进木桌，木屑和食物四处飞溅。

那位女性抓住战士，将她向后甩飞。

战士震惊地说：
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

女性：
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

场景4 — 火焰攻击 | 17–23秒

战士重新站起，再次冲上前。

那位女性深吸一口气。

她口中开始聚集起神秘的橙色光芒。

战士突然停住。

战士：
“What the hell are you doing?”

那位女性朝她吐出一股强大的魔法火焰。

营造出戏剧性、逼真的火焰效果，照亮整个酒馆。战士勉强躲过火焰，但仍被冲击力震飞出去。

场景5 — 败北 | 23–27秒

战士重重摔在木地板上。

那位女性平静地朝她走去。

战士试图爬开，神情完全呆住了。

战士：
“Okay… I admit it. I underestimated you.”

那位女性走近一步，一只脚稳稳地停在战士身旁，低头看着她。

场景6 — 最终镜头 | 27–30秒

女性面部特写。

她直视战士，神情平静，甚至带着一丝玩味。

女性，轻声说道：
“Next time… ask questions before swinging a sword.”

切黑。

视觉风格

超写实电影级奇幻影片，高预算电影制作，逼真的人脸，细致的皮肤纹理，自然的头发运动，符合物理规律的服装表现，真实的剑物理效果，可信的武术编排，电影级火焰 VFX，体积烟雾，温暖的灯笼照明，戏剧化阴影，浅景深，真实运动模糊，氛围粒子，细节丰富的中世纪酒馆环境，专业好莱坞级摄影。

在战斗过程中，使用广角建立镜头、低机位英雄镜头、中景对白镜头、特写、过肩镜头以及动态跟拍镜头的组合。

自然的英语口语对白，准确的口型同步。两位角色的声音要有明显区分。加入逼真的酒馆环境音、木质家具声、脚步声、剑击声、衣料摩擦声、火焰呼啸声、撞击声，以及细微的电影感背景音乐。
